notes.title: The Ghost Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32607805/6bf3337e40f5d52400221826deffcce8a4c0d974.png

Hello everyone,
Atomic Raccoon has been working reeeally hard to give you a first update on Stay Safe. We have seen players compete for the world records and we have listened to the community wishes. And so today, we give you : The Ghost Update.

 Ghosts
Activate them directly from the in game pause menu.
- World Record
- Personal Best 
- Steam Friends
Follow the path of the most insane players

UI 2.0 : Badges
- Badges for challenges :  Full Boost // No Dash // SS grade // Capsule collected
- Level selection menu : "Badges" display for each level
- Pause menu : Check directly in game your badegs on the current level
- Improved Blue color for colorblind
- Quit button from death screen
- "Esc" button on keyboard is now working each time it should

Various bug fixes 
- Capsule is now greyed properly
- Keyboard menu fixes
- Time display on leaderboard (some 0 were forgotten)


Stay up to date with the known issues and our current plans, join our Discord, or have a look at the Roadmap! We would love to hear your ideas.

Coming soon will be the Level Editor and then the Speedrun mode.

With love,
The Raccoons

notes.title: STAY SAFE DEMO : Ultimate No Death Challenge
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32607805/4c3de04d07666aaa4e54058362bfd2ebeb8f596e.gif

Welcome challengers !

If you got on this page you know that Stay Safe is a very challenging platformer that will put your nerve under pressure. And we have decided to host a very special contest for the bunch of greedy kids that you are.

Atomic Raccoon is glad to announce today the ULTIMATE NO DEATH CHALLENGE !

The one person who will finish the WHOLE DEMO without dying and with the shortest time among all contestants, will win a Stay Safe controller and a GAME CONSOLE of his choice. On our website & discord, we'll keep you updated with the latest results. You'll be able to see the contest leaderboard on those links:

Website
Discord

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32607805/55c52d6ff34573e5d54a2b299471adb4147fc287.png

THE RULES
The contest start on April 26 when the demo is live. It ends on May 1st at 10pm GMT+1 

The speedrun must be made live on Twitch, Youtube or Mixer.
If you have Twitter, when you start, make a tweet and tag us (@AtomicRaccoonFR) and add #sparemylife to it
You have to send a mail to edouard@atomicraccoon.com with your replay.

The mail must include :
[olist]
The time you spent to finish the whole game
Link to the twitch / youtube / mixer video replay that proves it
If necessary, indicate the time of BEGINNING of the speedrun and then ENDING of the speedrun. It'll help us check out the entry!
[/olist]
THE REWARDS
TOP 1: The person who finished the whole demo without dying AND has the best time will receive a Stay Safe skinned controller and the latest generation. Like a Switch, PS4, XboxOne (we don't give nes mini, sorry bois)
TOP 5: The 5 first people with the best time will receive a Purple S&M kit...
